methods.label: Find the middle integer
methods.explanation:
Consecutive even integers are spaced \(2\) apart. Among \(25\) integers, the middle one is the 13th, with \(12\) integers on each side.

Pair the smallest with the largest, the second smallest with the second largest, and continue toward the middle. In each pair, one integer is as far below the middle as its partner is above it. Each pair therefore has the middle integer as its average. Including the middle integer itself, the average of all \(25\) numbers is also that middle integer:

\[10{,}000\div25=400.\]

The largest integer is \(12\) gaps of size \(2\) above the middle, so it is

\[400+12\cdot2=\boxed{424},\]

choice \(\mathrm{E}\).
